scenes.line: Every production starts as a project. Choose New project, then Blank project.
scenes.caption: Start a project

scenes.line: Give it a name, and a line on what the production is.
scenes.caption: Name it

scenes.line: Add a cover, and frame it the way you want it seen.
scenes.caption: Add a cover

scenes.line: Pick the production type, then drop in your first stills, briefs or scripts.
scenes.caption: Type and first files

scenes.line: Create it, and the project page holds the cover, the story and the production details together.
scenes.caption: Your project page

scenes.line: Everything you upload lands in Files and references, sorted as it arrives.
scenes.caption: Files and references

scenes.line: Tag what each file is for: a reference, a raw file, work in progress, or a final asset.
scenes.caption: Tag each file

scenes.line: Final assets show up front, under the description, ready to share.
scenes.caption: Final assets, up front
